name: Lisa Zeiderman
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in New York, New York
about: As Managing and Senior Partner of Miller Zeiderman LLP, Lisa Zeiderman is dedicated to serving clients in Manhattan, New York, Kings, Westchester, Nassau, Suffolk, Rockland Orange and Dutchess County. She focuses her practice on matrimonial, divorce and family law, generally handling complex, high net worth divorce and high stakes financial and custody cases that involve equitable distribution, alimony, custody, child support, modifications, prenuptial and postnuptial agreements. and grandparent visitiation He cases frequently involve crypto currency, deferred compensation, restricted stock units, stock options, business valuations and equitable distribution of businesses and professional practices.

Ms. Zeiderman is a highly accomplished attorney who earned her law degree from Fordham Law, is a member of Chief and was named Crain's New York Notable Women for 2022 and 2023 and was also honored by Crains in 2024. She has been quoted in numerous publications most recently including the New Yorker. Ms, Zeiderman is both a Certified Financial Divorce Analyst and a Certified Financial Litigator.

Going through a divorce can be one of the most difficult experiences of a person's life. Having gone through her own divorce many years ago, Ms. Zeiderman understands the emotional and financial costs that family law issues often carry. She communicates honestly with her clients, and she offers them realistic guidance about their options and the risks that are involved with litigation. While Ms. Zeiderman has built a reputation as a strong negotiator, she is prepared to litigate her clients' issues in the courtroom when the other side is unwilling to compromise. Ms. Zeiderman works closely with her clients and strives to help them achieve favorable resolutions that meet their short and long-term needs. She has a "Superb" rating from Avvo.

Beyond the courtroom, Ms. Zeiderman is actively involved in the legal community. She is a member of the New York Women's Bar Association, New York State Bar Association and Chief. Ms. Zeiderman frequently publishes articles on family law topics in the New York Law Journal, has appeared on numerous podcasts and has her own blog at lisazeiderman.com. Ms. Zeiderman serves on several boards including Family Legal Care. She is Chair of the Savvy Ladies Board, an organization with a mission to foster women's financial empowerment through financial literacy. She also publishes a blog for Psychology Today. Additionally, Ms. Zeiderman is co-hosting a Podcast known as the Power of the Ask. Ms. Zeiderman is also an advisor to Hello Prenup,

Ms Zeiderman often drafts prenuptial and postnuptial agreements that involve high net worth assets and include fertility issues such as disposition of embryos. Ms. Zeiderman is prepared to draft your prenuptial and postnuptial agreements.
